description: This file defines server limit-related functions for the Mattermost application, including retrieving user limits, post history limits, and guest user tracking logic.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class providing server limit functionalities.

methods.name: GetServerLimits
methods.description: Retrieves current server limits including user and post history limits, considering license constraints.

methods.name: shouldTrackSingleChannelGuests
methods.description: Determines if single-channel guest tracking is enabled based on license and configuration.

methods.name: GetPostHistoryLimit
methods.description: Returns the post history limit based on the license.

methods.name: isAtUserLimit
methods.description: Checks if the current active user count has reached the maximum user limit.
